current_evidence: Merton's 'Apply for planning permission' page links this file as the 'Planning Application Validation Checklist 2025', updated for Local Plan 2024. The cover reads 'December 2024 (Updated June 2026)', and a web search found no later version.

issues.detail: Grokbot captured only about 20 distinct requirements, but the current checklist has 66 numbered items. The missing local items are listed here with their triggers. 8 Biodiversity Enhancement Statement (BNG-exempt applications). 9 Preliminary Ecological Appraisal (likely impact on protected species, priority habitats or designated sites). 10 Urban Greening Factor (major). 11 Supporting Planning Statement (major, major change of use, listed building, new dwellings). 12 Statement of Heritage Significance (LBC or impact on heritage assets). 16 Transport Statement (1 to 9 units or over 100m2 commercial). 17 Transport Assessment (all major). 19 Parking Survey (outside CPZs with poor PTAL). 24 Construction Logistics Plan. 25 Delivery and Servicing Plan (major). 26 Site Waste Management Plan (major). 29 Foul Sewage and Utilities Statement (major). 30 Affordable Housing Statement (10+ units or former employment sites). 31 Viability Report. 32 Marketing Report for change of use. 34 Statement of Community Involvement (major). 37 SAP/BRUKL outputs (1+ dwellings or 500m2+ non-residential). 38 GLA Carbon Reporting Spreadsheet. 40 Overheating Assessment. 41 Whole Life Carbon Assessment (30+ dwellings or 1,000m2+; minor demolish-and-rebuild of one dwelling). 42 Circular Economy Statement (Mayor-referable). 43 BREEAM Pre-Assessment. 44 National Water Standards Statement (any new dwellings). 45 Open Space Assessment (MOL or designated open space). 46 Playing Fields and Sport Facilities Assessment. 47 Play Strategy (major). 49 Archaeological Statement/Evaluation (APAs, near Scheduled Monuments, sites of 0.4ha+, EIA). 50 Acoustic Assessment. 51 Ventilation/Extraction Statement (commercial kitchen extraction). 52 Air Quality Assessment (major). 53 Air Quality Neutral (all development). 55 Residential Standards Statement (1+ dwellings). 56 Land Contamination Assessment (residential change of use within 50m of potentially contaminated land). 60 Health Impact Assessment (100+ homes or 10,000m2+). 61 Outbuildings/Granny Annexes Statement. 62 Section 96A and Section 73 documents. 66 Construction Traffic Management Plan (basements).
issues.evidence: Merton Council's Validation Checklist 2025 (Updated June 2026), items 1 to 66.

issues.detail: Three rows sit under 'Outline' only because the source item is called '65. Outline Construction Method Statement': Construction (Environmental) Management Plan, Basement Impact Assessment and 'Schedule of works (listed building)'. 'Outline' here describes the document, not the application type. Items 64, 65 and 66 apply to 'All schemes including basements or subterranean development', including householder basements.
issues.evidence: Row trigger: '65.Outline Construction Method Statement (CMS) All schemes including basements or subterranean development'.

issues.detail: Under Listed building consent, Grokbot lists 'Transport Assessment / Transport Statement', taken from the superseded 2024 v2 checklist. The trigger text is a garbled merge of the Transport Statement heading with the Structural Report row about listed buildings and buildings of heritage value. Transport statements are not an LBC requirement. The checklist's LBC items are Statement of Heritage Significance (12), Schedule of Works (13), Structural Impact Assessment (14) and Design and Access Statement (6), and none of these is mapped to LBC.
issues.evidence: Row trigger: 'Transport Statement Listed Building/other buildings of Heritage Value impact on the special character of the area may be required.' Current list item 13: 'Schedule of Works (Listed Buildings) - Listed building consent'.

issues.detail: All 20 Full planning rows are 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning', and Householder has only a Fire Statement row. Many checklist items apply to householder applications: PFSS/Reasonable Exception Statement (all developments), Biodiversity Enhancement Statement, Landscaping/Tree survey (extensions where trees are affected), FRA (Flood Zones 2/3), Statement of Heritage Significance, Basement Impact Assessment, and Outbuildings/Granny Annexes Statement (61). Variation of condition s73 and Non-material amendment are shown as '(none)', but item 62 requires 'Section 96A and Section 73 Documents' for all such applications.
issues.evidence: Item 62 'Section 96A and Section 73 Documents - All s96A and s73 applications'. Item 61 'Outbuildings / Granny Annexes Statement - Applications proposing outbuildings'.

issues.detail: The Fire Statement rows (Householder and Full planning) merge two separate requirements. Item 22, the London Plan D12A Planning Fire Safety Strategy / Reasonable Exception Statement, applies to all developments. Item 23, the Fire Statement, applies to all major development. Labelling a householder requirement as 'Fire Statement' misstates the trigger.
issues.evidence: Item 22 'Fire Safety Strategy / PFSS or Reasonable Exception Statement - All developments'. Item 23 'Fire Statement - All major development'.

issues.detail: Several labels do not match their triggers. 'Waste / Refuse and recycling storage details' uses item 63, 'All waste management applications' under the South London Waste Plan, which covers waste facility applications, not bin storage. 'Sequential / Exception Test (flood)' uses the retail town-centre sequential test text from item 33. 'Energy / Sustainability Statement' has EIA screening text. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' under Full planning has arboricultural method statement text. 'Existing and proposed site levels / sections' has the tree survey text.
issues.evidence: Row triggers: 'All waste management applications Refer to the Schedule ... South London Waste Plan 2022'; 'A sequential test is required where main town centre uses are proposed not in an existing centre'.

issues.detail: Many triggers are column-interleaved or cut off, so the threshold is lost. Travel Plan reads 'All proposals for car are required to submit a travel plan. free housing' (garbled 'car free housing'), and it omits the 20+ staff and over-50-homes thresholds. The Arboricultural row interleaves 'BS5837 comprising a dwelling or dwellings, or other a. a tree survey; developments where landscaping enhances b. ...'. The FRA row is interleaved and omits the Zone 2/3, Zone 1 over 1ha and critical drainage area thresholds. CIL reads 'of the CIL Regulations 2010 (as amended) 2.'. Pre-app reads 'of the pre-application advice. 64.'. Daylight reads 'and Average Daylight Factor (ADF) is required.'.
issues.evidence: Item 20 'Travel Plan Statements - 20+ staff, over 50 homes, or all car-free housing'. Item 27 FRA thresholds.

issues.detail: Grokbot also extracted from the older 'Merton Validations Checklist 2024 v2', which the council page still links. Rows cite both documents, for example the LBC Transport row, the Full planning 'Schedule of works' row and several tab items. The council page also says that permitted development, non-material amendments, advertisements, telecoms, tree works and listed buildings have separate checklists. Grokbot did not read these but still reported '(none)' for adverts and works to trees.
issues.evidence: Council page: the checklist 'applies to all application types ... other than with respect of permitted development, non-material amendments, advertisement consents, telecommunications prior notification, tree works and listed buildings with separate checklists for those applications.'

issues.detail: Some tab items are fragments or boilerplate rather than requirements. Examples: 'North arrow Page 7 of 39 Merton Council's Validation Checklist 2025 REQUIREMENTS THRESHOLD GUIDANCE 3.'; 'Block/Site Layout Plan ... identifying: a.'; 'Merton's Basement and Subterranean Planning Guidance SPD provides guidance ... Page 38 of 39'; and two garbled 'GHA-Overheating-in-New-Homes-Tool-and-Guidance.pdf schemes involving the (goodhomes.org.uk) creation or 1-9 dwellings' entries filed under Submission rules.
issues.evidence: tab_items 'Drawing / document standards' and 'Submission rules' entries.

issues.detail: The GHA overheating fragment and the drawing standards appear twice, once from the 2024 v2 checklist and once from the 2025 (Updated June 2026) checklist.
issues.evidence: tab_items entries sourced from both 'Merton Validations Checklist 2024 v2' and '260610 Local Validation Checklist 2025 (Updated)'.

issues.detail: The list date 2026-06-01 comes from the upload month in the URL path, not from the document. The document's own text gives 'December 2024 (Updated June 2026)', so the month is right but the original December 2024 date is not recorded.

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Merton checklist (December 2024, updated June 2026), but the extraction is very incomplete: about 20 of 66 requirements are captured, with dozens of local items missing (UGF, HIA, Air Quality, Circular Economy, Whole Life Carbon, Heritage Statement, Transport Statement/Assessment and others). Several rows are misassigned or misread, including basement items under 'Outline' and the PFSS confused with the Fire Statement.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
